calibration_metrics.fit_on: out-of-sample scores from the [2013] slice (model fitted on [2010, 2011, 2012])
calibration_metrics.selected_on: out-of-sample scores from the [2012] slice (model fitted on [2010, 2011])

primary.label: mature
primary.rule: A (issue_year, term) cell enters the primary split when at least 90% of its population loans are resolved.

secondary.label: immature
secondary.rule: Issue year >= 2017 (the original split, heavily right-censored).

lgd.pd_basis: champion score, probability-calibrated on a held-out temporal slice
lgd.ead_basis: expected EAD at default = funded_amnt x mean train ead_rate by grade

simulation.rho_note: Base case rho=0.12 (mid-range of the Basel IRB retail band); the grid spans 0.02-0.15 and includes the PD-dependent Basel formula value.

reject.label: EXPLORATORY - not used by any headline number

extrapolation_gap.note: Illustrative only: the rejected applicants have no observed outcome, so the gap cannot be validated. Common variables are requested amount and DTI.
